q1.explanationZh: 第一段说侄子相信每张卡都能给他超能力，或至少让他成为操场上最酷的孩子，也就是有力量、受欢迎。

evidence.quote: he believed that each one would give him superpowers—or at least make him the coolest kid on the playground.

q2.explanationZh: 第二段说他长大后不敢相信自己当年那么在意这些卡，说明他觉得那时的行为很傻。

evidence.quote: he can’t believe how much he once cared about those cards.

q3.explanationZh: 第二段说集卡就是为了融入集体，成为“俱乐部”的一员。

evidence.quote: It’s all about fitting in and being part of the “club”.

q4.explanationZh: 最后一段让孩子想想，为了集齐卡牌自己愿意付出多少、值不值得，也就是有没有必要集齐。

evidence.quote: Maybe it’s time to think about how far you would go—and whether it’s worth it—to complete your collection!

q5.explanationZh: 文章先讲集卡的“阴暗面”，再说它会变成花钱很多的恶性循环，目的是告诉大家集卡可能带来的危险。

evidence.quote: But there’s a dark side to all that shiny cardboard.
